product.description: Ești gata să faci o călătorie în jurul lumii? Vrei să afli care este diferența dintre elefantul african și cel asiatic? Care sunt cele mai cunoscute animale sălbatice din Africa? Sau unde trăiește dragonul de Komodo? Această carte de activități cu autocolante te va purta într-o călătorie fantastică pe toate continentele lumii. ### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q: Is this atlas suitable for very young children?**
A: The book is designed as an activity book that involves searching, sticking, and coloring. While highly engaging, it is ideal for pre-school to early elementary age groups who enjoy interactive learning.

**Q: Does the book teach about different continents?**
A: Yes, the purpose of this atlas is to take children on a journey around the world, helping them discover animals across every continent and understanding where they live.

**Q: Are educational materials included?**
A: The book contains rich illustrations and informative text alongside the activities, ensuring that learning about wildlife remains central to the experience.
